credits.title: Jailer 2
credits.overview: When a dangerous syndicate threatens his family, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver to battle enemies from the shadows.

credits.title: Gandhari
credits.overview: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

credits.title: Maa Behen
credits.overview: When trouble knocks on her door, a mother and her estranged daughters attempt to cover up a crime in a nosy colony where no secret is safe.

credits.title: Momacu
credits.overview: On a freezing winter night in rural Haryana, three men steal an ATM and hide it in a tube well room. Overnight, mistrust and chaos shatter their desperate plan.

credits.title: Na Jaane Kaun Aa Gaya
credits.overview: A love triangle. From Kaushal's breaking world to Tina's silent emotional conflict and Veer's transparent and blunt love, three hearts navigate guilt, longing, and impossible choices.

credits.title: Sikandar
credits.overview: A tragic accident pushes the powerful Sikandar to protect the less fortunate by standing up to corruption and greed — using any means necessary.

credits.title: Kofuku
credits.overview: Sadaf meets a stranger in a Café in Mussoorie who insists that he would show her around. What lay ahead is a rendezvous that changed Sadaf's perspective on her life.

credits.title: The Pop
credits.overview: "The Pop" is an overstated exploration of desire, longing and addiction in the life of a man who doesn't have too much.

credits.title: Chhalaang
credits.overview: Chhalaang humorously addresses the value of Sports Education in the school curriculum. It follows a hilarious, yet an inspirational journey of a typical PT Master from a semi government-funded school in Northern India, Montu, for whom it’s just a job and is forced to do what he has never done - Teach.

credits.title: Bamfaad
credits.overview: A passionate love story set in Allahabad between Naate and Neelam who meet accidentally and fall in love. They make brave choices and go through a path of love and loss to be with each other.

credits.title: Darbar
credits.overview: Aaditya, the commissioner of Mumbai Police, sets out to catch Ajay, a drug peddler. However, he uncovers a deeper controversy linked to an international drug lord and must mete out justice.

credits.title: Sonchiriya
credits.overview: A legion of warring bandits terrorizes India's Chambal Valley.

credits.title: Binnu Ka Sapna
credits.overview: ‘Binnu Ka Sapna’ delves deep into a malignant mindset, trying to bare the ticking time bombs around us and illuminate the wicks that light them.

credits.title: Meeruthiya Gangsters
credits.overview: A group of Meerut rogues aspire to become crime kingpins and local politicos. But, a major kidnapping makes them lose their all.

credits.title: Raja Natwarlal
credits.overview: Based on the story of a notorious real-life con man, this twisty Bollywood thriller revolves around cunning fraudster Raja Natwarlal, who pulls off a series of two-bit scams in Mumbai on his way to a big swindle. A small-time con man wants to get into the big leagues and take on a Goliath in the world of scams.
